headlines.title: Trump’s role in bringing Huang back to Nvidia met with bipartisan criticism
headlines.description: After President Trump shared news of his role in Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia as CEO, the move was met with sharp criticism on both sides of the political aisle. NBC News’ Chief White House Correspondent Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Congress reacts with anger and skepticism about Jensen Huang reinstatement
headlines.description: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle vowed to press ahead with investigations into the once-again Nvidia CEO, who’s scheduled to meet with them next week.

headlines.title: Court allows Trump admin. and Army to move forward with planned Iowa detonation
headlines.description: A U.S. appeals court said it would allow the Trump Administration and the Army to move forward with a detonation of lead azide in Iowa, denying an emergency request by environmental groups to halt the Army’s permit. NBC News' Courtney Kube discusses how the materials ended up in a small town in Iowa.

headlines.title: Democratic congressman resigns over sexual misconduct allegations
headlines.description: Democratic Congressman Jimmy Gomez said he disagreed with a devastating Ethics Committee report but will resign next week. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Wind and rain threaten Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
headlines.description: Travelers in the air and on the ground are bracing for bad weather later this week. In San Francisco, a powerful storm is expected to bring king tides and heavy flooding. In New York, there’s concern that rain and high winds could ground the Thanksgiving Day Parade balloons. Meanwhile, on this busy travel week, airlines have been managing a ground stop in Chicago and the residual effect from Delta’s computer outage this weekend. NBC News’ Tom Costello has the story.

headlines.title: Judge unseals documents related to search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home
headlines.description: Some of the unsealed court filings make clear the Trump administration believes violations of the law took place as far back as 1980.

headlines.title: Outrage over ICE arrest at Seattle-Tacoma airport
headlines.description: Distressing video shows the arrests of a father and daughter on a jet bridge at SeaTac airport over the weekend. NBC News’ Dana Griffin speaks to the husband of the daughter arrested about what happened in those moments captured on camera.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: $98 million civil judgment awarded in Ohio rape that could not be prosecuted
headlines.description: An Ohio woman who survived a brutal rape that went unsolved for decades was awarded a $98 million civil judgment against her attacker, a doctor who admitted to the assault but could not be prosecuted for it because the statute of limitations had expired.

headlines.title: Trump uses backdrop of DOJ to bash Gavin Newsom on death row commutations
headlines.description: President Donald Trump gave his speech at the Justice Department headquarters — a rarity for a president — and invited victims’ family members to speak onstage.

headlines.title: Amazon drone delivering shampoo snags on wire and tumbles onto Michigan man’s garage roof
headlines.description: James Brennan, of Huntington Woods, Michigan, near Detroit, said he had not requested a drone delivery and assumed his package would arrive at his doorstep as usual.
